value.caveat: CITES regulates international trade; it does not grant or deny local harvesting permission.

cites.source: CITES Species+ (trade listing, not collection permission)

value: Stage-structured counts of the local population (permanent plots, >=2 censuses)
Measured harvestable organ yield per plant/area at the site
Monitored survival/regrowth of harvested plants at the site (matched unharvested controls)
Voucher-verified species identity (e.g. Nardostachys jatamansi vs Valeriana jatamansi)
Documented collection rights / permits and community consent (FPIC) for the site
Expert-agreed sustainability threshold and monitoring interval

events.note: passport opened with prefilled scientific context

tasks.title: Verify species identity with a voucher specimen
tasks.detail: Look-alike and synonym confusion is common in medicinal plant trade (e.g. Nardostachys jatamansi vs Valeriana jatamansi). A voucher checked by a botanist is needed before collection is planned.

tasks.title: Upload the collection authorisation and confirm it with the issuing authority
tasks.detail: EthnoHarvest can read a document and check dates, species, organ and quantities against your records, but only the issuing authority can confirm that a permit is genuine and valid.

tasks.title: Screen CITES applicability before any cross-border trade
tasks.detail: Listed in CITES Appendix II. Whether a permit is needed depends on the product type, annotation and countries; confirm with the CITES Management Authority.

tasks.title: Confirm collection rights and community consent (FPIC) for the site
tasks.detail: Record who holds rights to the land and resource, and the consent of the community whose resource or knowledge is involved. EthnoHarvest cannot verify rights; a person must.

tasks.title: Agree a local review threshold with a qualified ecologist
tasks.detail: Any local harvest limit must come from site evidence and expert review, not from this software.

tasks.title: Measure harvestable yield per plant at the site
tasks.detail: Needed to relate a harvested mass to the number of plants affected.

tasks.title: Count plants by life stage on permanent plots at the site
tasks.detail: Published models describe other populations. Without local stage counts there is no basis for any site-specific harvest amount.

tasks.title: Set up monitoring of harvested and unharvested plants
tasks.detail: Survival and regrowth after harvest, compared with untouched controls, over several years.

not_a_permit: A Harvest Passport is an internal evidence and traceability record. It is not a government permit, a FairWild certificate, a validated local harvest quota, or an assurance of legal compliance or product safety.
